description: Graph-first spatial intelligence on the kotoba :feature/* Datom substrate (geocode / reverse / place search / H3-AVET chunking). Ships an おすすめ温泉 (onsen) discovery + transparent place-quality ranking: ingests hot-spring POIs from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, ODbL) and ranks them by public PLACE-facts (spring authenticity / notability / amenities) — a feature is a PLACED THING, never a person (G9); no per-person affect/profile/engagement metric, fully auditable via :why. Per ADR-2606064500.
displayNameJa: 地図 — 空間基盤 + 温泉おすすめ
